judgements.value: Demandez une modification ou du nouveau…
judgements.reason: Natural French for 'Ask for a change, or describe something new…'; 'du nouveau' is an idiomatic partitive and the shared verb covers both arms. It names no single object and cannot read as messaging the open agent. The compression is required by the sidecar: it is 40 characters and measures 290.27 px at 14 px SF Pro, versus the English 301.17 px (the same method reproduces the recorded native 301.1709 px exactly), inside the 304 px content box; a more literal '…ou décrivez quelque chose de nouveau…' would lengthen it past the constraint.

judgements.value: Publication de « {name} » vers {destination} / Publication de « {name} » sur le Hub des agents
judgements.reason: The nominal is a natural French status/receipt title; it carries no question mark and cannot be confused with the interrogative sibling ('Publier … ?'), and it does not read as a first-publication imperative. The org receipt names the destination and does not imply the public hub. If the manager prefers an explicit past participle, '« {name} » publié vers {destination}' is available, but it is not required for meaning or register.

'vers' is the flow's shipped destination vocabulary: ui.agents.upload.target.label 'Publier vers' and ui.agents.upload.target.orgs_unread '…pour publier vers une organisation'. Changing it to 'dans' would diverge from the dialog's own target control for no gain.

One short word, the standard fr rendering of a Get button and already shipped ('Obtenir {name}', 'Obtenir un code de connexion'). Measured 43.49 px versus 20.58 px for 'Get' at the sm button's 12 px medium step (+22.9 px). The footer is flex-wrap by design; a min-width card with single-digit counters sums to about 243.5 px of the 256 px content box (derived from the button/footer classes plus the measured text widths, not a DOM measurement), so it still fits at the common case, and the component drops the action to a second line rather than clipping when counters grow (the same behaviour the English has).

A clear, idiomatic antonym pair; 'Afficher moins' is already shipped (ui.schedules.wake_conversation_row.show_fewer), and 'Tout afficher' is the common fr expander. Both are one or two short words and the link sizes to its content (73.75 px / 84.29 px at 12 px), so the 48 px English reference box is not a fixed slot.

The note requires a fact, not a verb; 'Délégation' is the shipped noun for this capability (ui.agents.detail.section.delegation 'Délégation et effort') and one word, so it does not push the meta line to a second row. Read as a capability in a dot-separated facts line, not as a second feature.

The in-flight arm is distinguished from the idle 'Réessayer' (shipped ui.common.actions.retry/retry_again) and the same phrase is already shipped for a retrying state (ui.chat.pickers.usage_view.retrying). Two words rather than the hint's one, but there is no idiomatic one-word French form; it sits in a flex-wrap status line and measures 123.20 px at 13 px, so it wraps rather than clips.
